title: MEIKO — What I Need To Do〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you think Mizuki's really gonna show up for those supplementary classes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's a case of show up or get held back, right...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which means Mizuki has to attend...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: On top of being a really nice person, Mizuki cares deeply about any immediate family and friends.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mizuki's going to show up in order to not cause them any further trouble.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, that certainly sounds like what Mizuki would do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I plan to be on Mizuki's phone for the entire day.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. If you can find out how Mizuki's doing, then we'll be able to tell Ena and the others.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, for their sake, the rest of us should stay here in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you also okay with that, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you do get a chance to talk to Mizuki, please also make it clear how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've been watching over Mizuki for a very long time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So I believe your feelings and your words carry much more weight compared to the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I seem to have access to the phone, but it's still pitch black in here...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But those supplementary classes don't take place until after school. Until then, I should keep an eye on things.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Sounds like Mizuki's getting ready to leave...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I need to tell Luka, Ena and the others.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I thought we'd suddenly changed course at an intersection. I'm guessing we've stopped somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(We don't seem to be moving at all...
Is going to school not the plan now?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (That means Ena won't be able to find Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've been watching over Mizuki for a very long time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So I believe your feelings and your words carry much more weight compared to the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Now, they just need to talk and...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (If Mizuki decides to run at full speed, Ena's never going to catch up...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Are you really going to run from her?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (You may never see her again if you do...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (If I don't do something, things won't end well...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I have to give Ena a chance to say what she's feeling...!)
